hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for NASDANK pools that charges a configurable fee always denominated in WETH on every swap in both directions. Uses beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas to take the fee from the WETH leg, accruing it to per-pool balances that are split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury via a permissionless claim function.
